# Daily X Report — 2026-11-09

Today's main thread is the Nvidia / Jensen Huang turmoil and its market impact: NVDA fell over 5% premarket, wiping out about $225B in market value; Nasdaq-100 futures first dropped, then recovered, and by the evening US futures were higher with oil below $90/bbl. On the AI side, the highlights remain the Nov 7 research and tool updates: Claude's memory and "dreaming", the BioBasicsBench wet-lab benchmark, and AI agents finding weaknesses in 1024-bit RSA.

## 1. AI Practical / Agents

### 1. Claude's memory and "dreaming": how agents learn from experience
Anthropic describes Claude's memory mechanism: "dreaming" helps Claude organize what it learned, correct errors, and find needed information faster next time — a key piece of how long-running agents accumulate experience.
Post: https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2118814753154064501

### 2. BioBasicsBench: testing AI agents with real wet-lab experiments
OpenAI and enzyme-design company Ligo launched BioBasicsBench, a wet-lab science benchmark using 100 real experimental tasks to test whether agents can interpret raw experimental data, spot errors, and judge whether evidence supports conclusions, with biosecurity relevance.
Post: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118782708767965238

### 3. AI agents accelerate cryptanalysis: two weaknesses found in 1024-bit RSA
With human guidance, AI agents accelerated stress-testing of encryption systems and found two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA; the work warns against relying on historical hardness assumptions, while modern 2048-bit systems were not affected by this specific attack.
Post: https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2118755418675765656

### 4. Cross-vendor jailbreak rating framework 1.0
OpenAI, with the Frontier Model Forum and member companies, released Jailbreak Rating Framework 1.0 to judge when bypassing AI safeguards could cause serious cyber harm and prioritize defenses — an attempt at a unified, comparable evaluation method.
Post: https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118795218099253606

### 5. How AI is changing scientific modeling
An Anthropic science-blog guest post: AI can write scientific models as code — writing, running, fitting, and revising them — to explore multiple model structures and test which explanations the data supports, with examples from neuron firing to neutron-star collisions.
Post: https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2118792930211107115

## 2. AI Video & World Models

### 6. GPT Image 2.6 arrives on Runway
GPT Image 2.6 is now available on Runway, with 50% faster generation, GIF support, SVG vector export, and precise edits that keep characters, products, and brand details consistent — directly useful for brand and product visual work.
Post: https://x.com/runwayml/status/2118735600241270879

## 3. Finance & Markets

### 7. Nvidia falls over 5% premarket, about $225B in market value wiped out
Nvidia $NVDA fell over 5% at the premarket open amid the Jensen Huang situation, wiping out about $225B in market value; Nasdaq-100 futures first fell over 1%, then erased the drop and turned higher as investors bought the dip.
Post: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119717185492775004

### 8. China denies allegations linked to the Nvidia / Jensen Huang situation
China formally denied that its intelligence agencies were involved in allegations around Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, calling them "baseless speculation and slander"; Nvidia's board is conducting an independent investigation.
Post: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119743299581772212

### 9. US futures rise, oil drops below $90/bbl
US futures rose as traders bought the tech dip, and oil fell below $90/bbl; S&P 500 +0.7%, Nasdaq 100 +0.5%, Dow +1.1%, WTI -2.9%, Brent -3.0%, gold +1.1%, with the S&P 500 set to open above 7,400.
Post: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119764943935304087

### 10. US data-center construction spending up 90% YoY, a record high
US data-center construction spending rose 90% year over year in September, a record high; annualized spending has reached about $34B, up about 17x since 2010 — hard data behind the AI infrastructure boom.
Post: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119590794830958827

### 11. Berkshire Hathaway plans yen bond sale
Berkshire Hathaway has hired banks for its first yen bond sale since April, according to people familiar with the matter.
Post: https://x.com/business/status/2119603414011174937

### 12. 221 US trucking companies have gone bankrupt in 2026
221 US trucking companies have gone bankrupt so far in 2026, heading for the highest level on record — a sign of pressure on freight and the real economy.
Post: https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119636362810859821

# 今日推特精选报告（2026-11-09）

今日主线是英伟达 / 黄仁勋风波及其市场冲击：英伟达盘前一度跌超 5%、市值蒸发约 2250 亿美元，纳指期货早盘先跌后涨，晚间美股期货回升、油价跌破 90 美元。与此同时，AI 一侧 11 月 7 日的几条重磅研究与工具更新仍是亮点：Claude 的记忆与“做梦”机制、BioBasicsBench 湿实验基准、AI 智能体发现 1024 位 RSA 弱点。

## 一、AI 实用 / Agent

### 1. Claude 的记忆与“做梦”：智能体如何从经验中学习
Anthropic 介绍 Claude 的记忆机制，称“做梦”式整理能帮助 Claude 组织所学、纠正错误，并在下次更快找到所需信息；这是理解长期运行的智能体如何积累经验的关键一环。
原帖：https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2118814753154064501

### 2. BioBasicsBench：用真实湿实验检验 AI 智能体
OpenAI 与酶设计公司 Ligo 合作推出湿实验科学基准 BioBasicsBench，用 100 个真实实验任务检验智能体解读原始实验数据、发现错误和判断证据是否支持结论的能力，关联生物安全。
原帖：https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118782708767965238

### 3. AI 智能体加速密码分析，1024 位 RSA 现两处弱点
在人类指导下，AI 智能体加速加密系统压力测试，在传统 1024 位 RSA 中发现两处重大弱点；提示不能再依赖历史硬度假设，需持续对密码标准做压力测试，现代 2048 位系统未受此次特定攻击影响。
原帖：https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2118755418675765656

### 4. 跨厂商越狱评级框架 1.0
OpenAI 与 Frontier Model Forum 及成员公司发布越狱评级框架 1.0，用于判断绕过 AI 防护是否可能造成严重网络危害并优先加强防护，尝试建立统一的可比较评估方法。
原帖：https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118795218099253606

### 5. AI 如何改变科学建模
Anthropic 科学博客客座文章：AI 可把科学模型写成代码并进行编写、运行、拟合与修订，探索多种模型结构并检验哪种解释得到数据支持，涉及神经元放电与中子星碰撞等实例。
原帖：https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2118792930211107115

## 二、AI 视频与世界模型

### 6. GPT Image 2.6 上线 Runway
GPT Image 2.6 接入 Runway，生成速度提升 50%，支持 GIF、导出 SVG 矢量，并在精确编辑时保持角色、产品与品牌细节一致，对品牌与产品视觉工作有直接参考价值。
原帖：https://x.com/runwayml/status/2118735600241270879

## 三、金融与市场

### 7. 英伟达盘前跌超 5%，市值蒸发约 2250 亿美元
英伟达 $NVDA 在盘前交易开盘时因黄仁勋相关事态跌超 5%，当日已抹去约 2250 亿美元市值；纳指期货早盘一度跌逾 1%，随后抹去跌幅转涨，投资者在消息后逢低买入。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119717185492775004

### 8. 中方否认与英伟达 / 黄仁勋事态有关的指控
中方正式否认其情报机构卷入英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋相关事态的指控，称其为“毫无根据的猜测和诽谤”；英伟达董事会正在进行独立调查。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119743299581772212

### 9. 美股期货上涨，油价跌破 90 美元/桶
美股期货上涨，交易员逢低买入科技股，油价跌破 90 美元/桶；标普 500 +0.7%、纳斯达克 100 +0.5%、道指 +1.1%、WTI -2.9%、布伦特 -3.0%、黄金 +1.1%，标普 500 有望在 7400 点上方开盘。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119764943935304087

### 10. 美国数据中心建设支出同比增 90% 创历史新高
美国数据中心建设支出 9 月同比增长 90%，创历史新高；按年化计算支出已达约 340 亿美元，自 2010 年以来该支出增长约 17 倍，是 AI 基建热度的数据佐证。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119590794830958827

### 11. 伯克希尔拟发行日元债券
据知情人士称，伯克希尔·哈撒韦已聘请银行进行自 4 月以来的首次日元债券发售。
原帖：https://x.com/business/status/2119603414011174937

### 12. 2026 年已有 221 家美国卡车运输公司破产
2026 年至今已有 221 家美国卡车运输公司破产，正走向有记录以来最高水平，反映货运与实体经济承压。
原帖：https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2119636362810859821
